interpretation: The local exact batch 827 succeeds after the same ordered count of prior exact corpus transactions, so this local current-code run does not reproduce the hosted failure. It cannot establish whether the hosted transaction committed, aborted, or remains pending.
The Luffy link-to-title query resolves one additional link after more page-title facts become available (13 to 14 rows); both complete unordered typed row multisets matched the approved prefix data.

The three-clause join uses 18 scans and 273 shard requests at both checkpoints. Its local median round-trip grows from 756 ms to 3040 ms while its result grows by one row, motivating further investigation of repeated broad title lookups.
Samples are small and include warm-up outliers. These local timings are not Cloudflare hosted latency, p95/p99, capacity evidence, or a production optimization claim.
